P25-05.name: The RevelationDragon Bahattar
P25-05.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Awakened Dragon & C4 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents/Attacks)
You can return an opposing Spirit/Burst to the deckbottom. When you've done so, you can put a core from the Void to your Spirits/Reserve.

[LV2][LV3]
When your "Awakened Dragon" family Spirits would leave the Field due to an opposing effect, you can activate this Spirit's (When Advents) effect.
